## Control percentile inputs

All XAU records embed the 200 tape-replayed random-entry means and 200 realized-sequence permutation means under `control_percentile_inputs` in the hash-chained ledger. Checkpointed BTC records retain their computed percentiles, deterministic seed, ensemble sizes, and methods; append-only evidence was not rewritten.

## Controls auditor

Random controls are 200 genuine tape replays with matched empirical holding and stop distributions and full per-trade costs. Shuffle controls are 200 permutations of the realized net trade sequence. Synthetic Bernoulli payoffs are absent.

## Leakage auditor

Complete canonical-minute decision bars are labelled at their final minute; signals decide at close and execute next open. Development-only selection and confirmation are isolated.

## Statistical auditor

Full-ledger DSR multiplicity, CSCV PBO, LOYO, sample floors, year concentration, confirmation firewall, and 0.70 haircut are fail-closed.

## Cost and execution auditor

The entry cost/stop gate and median eligibility use 0.15. Stops, targets, and maximum holdings are fixed. Gross, base provisional, haircut, and 2x-cost expectancy are reported. XAU swap is charged per held UTC night and both sides of the 2017 seam are tested. BTC 4h/1d records note the LOCK_A funding gap; weekend policies are SWING_REQUIRED.

## Ledger and holdout auditor

Every one of the 56 configurations is in the append-only hash chain. The holdout audit passed before and after execution; no holdout shard was opened.
